name: Broadband disconnections
description: Home broadband/fibre internet drops repeatedly, disconnects at certain times, or is completely down for one customer (red LOS light, no internet).

name: Slow broadband speed
description: Broadband works but is slower than the plan, speed reduced after the data limit (FUP), or weak WiFi in some rooms.

name: Router and WiFi setup
description: WiFi password or name change, router reset and reconfiguration, devices unable to join WiFi, 5G home router setup.

name: Installation and shifting
description: New connection installation delays, missed technician appointments, shifting the connection to a new address.

name: Mobile network and coverage
description: No signal, emergency calls only, call drops, poor indoor coverage, no network after travelling.

name: Mobile data problems
description: Mobile data (4G/5G) not working or very slow, APN problems, daily data quota exhausted.

name: SIM, eSIM and number porting
description: New or replacement SIM not activated, KYC verification, eSIM setup, number portability (port in/out) delays or rejections.

name: Roaming
description: International roaming activation, no network abroad, unexpected roaming charges on the bill.

name: DTH signal and set-top box
description: DTH TV shows no signal or error codes, picture freezing, dish alignment, set-top box not starting.

name: DTH channels and recharge
description: Channels missing after recharge, adding or removing channel packs, DTH recharge not reflected.

name: Billing and payments
description: Wrong or unexpected charges on the bill, payment deducted but not credited, double debit, auto-pay failures, late fees.

name: Plan change and information
description: Upgrading or downgrading a plan, plan information, data top-ups and booster packs.

name: Area outage
description: Many customers in the same area lose service at the same time: fibre cut, tower down, exchange power failure.

name: Legal, regulatory and privacy
description: Customer threatens or sends a legal notice, approaches consumer court, TRAI, ombudsman or a grievance portal, or raises data privacy, data deletion or data leak concerns.

name: Fraud and account security
description: SIM swap, unauthorised SIM/eSIM change or porting, account takeover, OTP misuse, money lost because of the number being hijacked.

name: Refunds and compensation
description: Customer demands a refund, waiver or compensation above the agent limit (more than Rs 500, full month rental, cash refund).
